feat(selection): Add size method to Selection interface

Adds a new `size()` method to the `Selection` interface and provides
implementations in `SelectionImpl` and `GrantsAwareSelectionImpl`.
This allows consumers to easily query the current number of selected items.

Additionally, optimizes the `add` method in both implementations to
avoid unnecessary `updateFlow` calls if the item being added is already
present in the selection.

Includes corresponding unit tests for the new `size()` method.
